title: Onboard aurora-xt-13b v1.0 — metadata, perf profiles, changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
body: Context: This PR adds the new open model aurora-xt-13b v1.0 to the model registry. Changes include structured metadata (model_type, tokenizer, quantization profiles), a set of performance profiles collected across representative sequence-length distributions and hardware targets, and automation to surface changelog/release notes entries for onboarding. Motivation: aurora-xt-13b provides a strong latency/quality tradeoff for mid-sized workloads and needs curated perf profiles and metadata for the Serving runtime to pick optimal kernels and quantization settings. Scope: 1) registry metadata JSON + schema validation; 2) perf profiles for 16/32/64 token distributions on both A100-40GB and T4; 3) integration with changelog automation so onboarding events generate a release note draft and an entry in model-changelog.md; 4) small docs snippet in onboarding guide. What I changed: - models/aurora-xt-13b/v1.0/metadata.json: new model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, default quantization matrix, recommended batch sizes). - models/aurora-xt-13b/v1.0/perf_profiles/*.json: three perf profile JSONs with latency/throughput/p95 and recommended kernel/quant settings per hw type. - scripts/changelog-gen/onboard_event_handler.py: hooks that synthesize a release note entry from metadata and perf summary. - docs/model-onboarding.md: brief paragraph about aurora-xt and validation steps. - tests/test_model_schema.py: added validation cases for new schema fields and a fixture for perf_profile parsing. - ci/workflows/model-registry.yml: added a job to smoke-validate newly added perf profiles. Testing: perf profiles were generated from internal benchmark-lab runs (bench ids included below) and validated against schema and CI. See testing_summary below for details. Rollout: gated rollout in model catalog UI and CLI; default not visible to hosted customers until a manual enable flag is flipped. Checklist: - [x] Metadata schema validated - [x] Perf profiles validated and CI smoke test passed - [x] Changelog automation generates draft entry - [x] Docs updated - [x] Reviewed and approved by reviewers Notes: the changelog automation intentionally leaves the release-note in draft mode so product can edit wording before publish. See commits and review conversation for details.
commits: c1a4f2f: add aurora-xt metadata schema and example
b3d9e5a: add perf profile - a100-40gb - seq16/32/64
f8a1c12: add perf profile - t4 - seq16/32/64
e2d7b44: add changelog automation handler and unit tests
d4b8f11: tests: model schema + perf profile parsing fixtures
review_comments: Evelyn Park (reviewer): Left a few nits on schema field names — prefer 'default_quant' -> 'recommended_quant' for clarity.
Maya Chen (author): Updated metadata.json to rename default_quant -> recommended_quant and added a fallback_quant entry for legacy runtime.
Arjun Patel (reviewer): Asked for clarification on how perf profiles map to kernel selection; added a suggestion to include a short mapping table in README.
Maya Chen (author): Added mapping table to models/aurora-xt-13b/v1.0/README.md and included kernel heuristics in the perf_profile comments.
Liam O'Connor (approver): Verified CI and bench IDs. Approved with minor docs nits.
testing_summary: Perf profiles generated from benchmark-lab runs (bench id 29871) using representative workloads. Profiles report median latency, p95, throughput and recommended batch/kv settings. Unit tests ensure schema compatibility and perf_profile parser resilience. CI smoke job runs a lightweight load test against a local serving runtime to ensure kernels and quant paths are selectable.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: registry recording and internal QA (complete). Stage 2: expose model in Dedicated/Dedicated-beta for partner customers (manual enable). Stage 3: public catalog listing after one-week QA window and product approval. Changelog automation will generate a draft release note in .changelogs/drafts/aurora-xt-13b-v1.0.md for editorial review.
release_notes: Add aurora-xt-13b v1.0: curated metadata and performance profiles for a100/t4; automatic changelog entry generation enabled (draft).
notes: This PR intentionally keeps the model hidden from public hosted catalog until product review. Perf profiles include a conservative and an aggressive quantization recommendation; runtime will choose conservative by default.
